raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #48221.

`PR Test (Arm64) / build-test` fails on main since #47731:

```
AttributeError: '_OpNamespace' 'sgl_kernel' object has no attribute 'fused_experts_cpu'
```

`test_moe.py` uses `torch.ops.sgl_kernel` without importing `sgl_kernel`, so it depended on the `sglang` import chain loading the op library. That chain no longer does.

## Modifications

Add `import sgl_kernel  # noqa: F401` to `test/registered/cpu/arm64/test_moe.py`, same as the other CPU tests.

## Tests

On 57bfde9f2c (main), `docker/arm64.Dockerfile` built from a fresh clone, native linux/arm64, running the CI steps from `pr-test-arm64.yml`:

| | `test_moe.py` | `base-b-test-cpu-arm64` |
|---|---|---|
| main | `FAILED (errors=16)`, the AttributeError above | 7/10 passed |
| this PR | OK | 10/10 passed |

cc @hnyls2002 @ranimandepudi

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).

- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
